assets.name: hero-botanical
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: website artwork for a Chinese medicine and acupuncture clinic, one image in a cohesive seven-part series.
Style/medium: traditional Chinese ink-wash painting (æ°´å¢¨ç”», shui mo hua), expressive xieyi brushwork on warm ivory xuan paper. This must look hand-painted with a calligraphy brush: economical strokes, dry-brush edges, watery ink blooms, pools of dilute pigment, purposeful unpainted paper, visible brush energy. Flat pictorial space and suggestive forms. Use deep jade-green ink instead of pure black, gentle sage washes, one restrained muted clay accent where natural. Paper color approximately #f7f3eb, ink #28594b and #26352e. Quiet, refined, artist-made, culturally grounded Chinese brush painting.
Composition: landscape 3:2 canvas, approximately 1536 by 1024 pixels. The painted subject occupies a considered portion of the frame with generous ivory negative space. Full rectangular paper, no picture frame or vignette. Subtle rice-paper fibers, not a distressed or grunge texture.
Constraints: no text, no calligraphy writing, no characters, no signature, no stamps, no red seal, no logo or watermark, no medical promises. Absolutely no photorealism, no photographic skin, no depth-of-field, no 3D rendering, no cinematic lighting, no Western oil-painting brush texture, no cartoon faces, no stock-photo styling.

Subject: a graceful ginkgo branch with recognizable fan-shaped leaves, accompanied by one slender bamboo stem and a few bamboo leaves. Brush-painted botanical study, expressive foliage and spare stems, concentrated in the center-right for a website hero and flexible portrait cropping. Green-ink leaves range from rich ink to pale watery wash; leave surrounding ivory paper open. No vase, table, room, or props. The feeling is growth, balance, and quiet care.
